column3: NKJV has the order “Am I not an apostle? Am I not free?” and “Jesus Christ our Lord,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text puts “free” first and reads “Jesus our Lord.”
NKJV has “in hope should be partaker of his hope,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “in hope of partaking.”
NKJV has “the gospel of Christ,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the gospel.”
NKJV lacks “though not being myself under the law,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text includes it.
NKJV has “this I do,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “all things I do.”
